status: reviewable configuration description; not directly deployable

umas_content.role: full-source UMAS ingestion and flat projection
umas_content.deactivation_action: uw with full source and publishingStatus=INACTIVE
umas_content.full_source_requirement: All non-delete events contain the full source document. Only d is ID-only; the input schema cannot enforce action-specific completeness.

pipeline.fingerprint_rules: keys, boosts and token format pending configuration

conditional_derived_include: brand_names only when Brand enrichment is enabled

output_decorator_contract.date_source: relevantAiringInfo[].datetime from the same distributionTenant entry
output_decorator_contract.date_reset: Emit every configured date field on each full-source update; null for absent tenant or datetime.
output_decorator_contract.airing_cardinality: zero or one entry per tenant; duplicate/invalid values are errors, never max(datetime)
output_decorator_contract.missing_owned_visibility_root: normalise to [] before scheduling under the full-source contract
output_decorator_contract.other_owned_resets: emit [] for absent selected lists and null for absent selected nullable scalars; never reset Metadata/counter fields
output_decorator_contract.relevant_airing_output: retain selected flattened arrays; derived tenant fields are authoritative for date queries

umas_content.state_evaluator: Rebuild every aggregate from eligible $active windows; return [true,payload]. INACTIVE or no eligible windows emits all four arrays as [].

metadata.role: parallel enrichment; detailed fields/provider out of scope
metadata.field_ownership: Own metadata plus own fingerprint contribution only; extend strict mapping before activation.
metadata.notifications: AWS external configuration; producer decides next action; no automatic resubmission

counters.role: dedicated counter snapshot UPDATE on existing content
counters.counter_semantics: Absolute assignment of complete owned snapshot; null clears unknown/inapplicable, zero is measured. No increments or fingerprint writes.
counters.initial_cadence: once daily from Analytics; independent of continuous UMAS lane
open_items: Producer confirmation of 36 fields, AVOD/SVOD labels, paired views windows and null convention
